title: Whistleblower saw a Tic Tac offloaded from a ship

tellings.quote: and we have a whistleblower who saw it being offloaded out of a a big ship uh out of the uh in 1991, I believe.

plain: A Tic Tac, a white oval craft shaped like the mint, is said to have been unloaded from a big ship, around 1991 as he remembers it, according to the UFO activist Steven Greer, who says an unnamed whistleblower of his saw it happen. If true, it would mean such craft are held, and moved around, by people on Earth.
